A clean high-key live-action lifestyle portrait of a young adult woman sitting sideways on a white upholstered sofa beside a very bright window, photographed vertically from close range with her bent legs occupying much of the lower foreground. Her hips rest near the lower-right corner, one thigh extends diagonally across the bottom edge and the other knee bends upward along the left side. Her upper body leans gently against the back of the sofa while she twists her shoulders and turns her head back toward the camera. One forearm rests along the sofa back, and both hands loosely hold a small clear glass containing a pale drink, with a short white stirrer or spoon carrying a tiny orange-red accent. Her fingers curve naturally around the glass without rigid spacing. She wears loose mint-green shorts, a white ribbed bandeau-style inner top and an open-knit sleeveless camisole with horizontal white and pale sage stripes. The chunky knit texture, open stitches and soft drape remain clearly visible. Her black hair is gathered into a casual high bun with an uneven knot, straight wispy bangs and several loose strands blown across her eyes, nose and lips. She looks directly over her shoulder with wide dark eyes, relaxed eyebrows, softly parted rose-pink lips and a calm attentive expression. The window and sofa create a nearly white background, with only a pale defocused band of fresh green foliage outside. Broad diffused daylight surrounds the subject from behind and left, overexposing large sections of the window and white upholstery while preserving gentle warm-gray shadows under her jaw, along the arm and between the legs. The color palette is airy and restrained: milky white, pale mint, soft sage, warm ivory skin and charcoal-black hair. Very low contrast, bright exposure, translucent skin highlights and clean pastel separation. This is a polished contemporary digital photograph rather than a coarse film scan: use crisp but gentle optical detail, smooth tonal transitions, minimal sensor noise and almost no visible grain. Maintain fine skin texture, subtle pores, tiny arm hairs, natural knee and elbow shapes, irregular hair strands and physically accurate knit fabric so the image remains recognizably live-action rather than synthetic or porcelain-smooth.

A square close-up summer snapshot of a young adult Chinese woman leaning slightly toward the camera as a burst of water splashes across the right side of her face. She squeezes both eyes shut and puckers her coral-red lips, capturing an unplanned playful reaction at the exact moment of impact. She has a soft rounded face, natural cheek volume, a small nose, damp black hair tied into two low loose pigtails, and thin wet bangs separated unevenly across her forehead. She wears a pale blue-and-white striped sleeveless top with narrow straps, slightly darkened by moisture. The water enters from camera-right in an irregular spray, with larger transparent droplets crossing her cheek and nose, fine mist suspended around her head, and several foreground droplets becoming soft white circles. Bright natural daylight from the upper left creates pale highlights on her forehead, cheek, wet shoulders and collarbones, while soft cool-gray shadows remain beneath the bangs, jaw and neck. The plain background is defocused blue-gray with a faint lavender cast. Use low saturation, powder blue, milky white, pale peach skin, charcoal-black hair and restrained coral lips. Preserve visible pores, small skin marks, damp flyaway strands and uneven wet texture. Moderate shallow depth of field, compact-camera softness, subtle color-negative grain, mild JPEG texture, slightly compressed highlights and gently blurred water particles create the atmosphere of a candid early-2000s summer photograph, fresh, awkward and physically immediate, with no watermark, text, logo or interface overlay.
